import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
csv_path = 'inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv'
xlsx_path = 'inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx'
# Expression matrix (skip the annotation row)
expr = pd.read_csv(csv_path, skiprows=1)
# Deduplicate by keeping the first occurrence
expr = expr.drop_duplicates(subset='id', keep='first').reset_index(drop=True)
print("Expression after dedup:", expr.shape)
# Differential analysis results
diff = pd.read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet_name='Sheet 1')
print("Differential analysis:", diff.shape)
# Merge on gene id
merged = diff.merge(expr, on='id', how='inner')
print("Merged:", merged.shape)
print(merged[['id', 'log2FoldChange', 'pvalue']].head())
# Save merged table to a CSV for the R session
merged_out = merged[['id', 'log2FoldChange', 'pvalue']].copy()
merged_out.to_csv('processed/diff_results.csv', index=False)
print("\nSaved processed/diff_results.csv:", merged_out.shape)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
# --- 1. Load and prepare data ---
df <- read.csv('processed/diff_results.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# Remove NA
df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(pvalue))
# Compute -log10(p) (cap at a sensible max to avoid Inf)
df$neg_log10_p <- -log10(df$pvalue)
df$neg_log10_p[df$neg_log10_p > 50] <- 50
# --- 2. Cutoffs (typical "diagonal" volcano uses joint thresholds) ---
fc_cut   <- 1           # |log2FC| >= 1
p_cut    <- 0.05        # p-value <= 0.05
k        <- 1           # slope of diagonal
intercept <- -log10(p_cut)  # 1.301
# Build the two diagonal cutoff lines
x_line <- seq(-max(abs(df$log2FoldChange)),
              max(abs(df$log2FoldChange)), length.out = 200)
diag_df <- data.frame(
  x = c(x_line, x_line),
  y = c(intercept + k * abs(x_line), intercept + k * abs(x_line)),
  side = c(rep("up", length(x_line)), rep("down", length(x_line)))
)
# --- 3. Classify genes ---
df$status <- "NS"
df$status[df$log2FoldChange >=  fc_cut & df$pvalue <= p_cut] <- "Up"
df$status[df$log2FoldChange <= -fc_cut & df$pvalue <= p_cut] <- "Down"
cat("Counts:\n")
print(table(df$status))
# Top 10 by |log2FC|
top_up <- df %>% filter(status == "Up") %>%
  arrange(pvalue) %>% head(5) %>% pull(id)
top_down <- df %>% filter(status == "Down") %>%
  arrange(pvalue) %>% head(5) %>% pull(id)
cat("\nTop 5 Up:  ", paste(top_up, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Top 5 Down:", paste(top_down, collapse=", "), "\n")
df$label <- ifelse(df$id %in% c(top_up, top_down), df$id, "")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
# --- 1. Load and prepare data ---
df <- read.csv('processed/diff_results.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(pvalue))
df$neg_log10_p <- -log10(df$pvalue)
df$neg_log10_p[df$neg_log10_p > 50] <- 50
# --- 2. Cutoffs (typical "diagonal" volcano uses joint thresholds) ---
fc_cut   <- 1
p_cut    <- 0.05
k        <- 1
intercept <- -log10(p_cut)  # ~1.301
# Build the two diagonal cutoff lines (the signature of "Synthetic volcano plot")
x_line <- seq(0, max(abs(df$log2FoldChange)) + 1, length.out = 200)
diag_pos <- data.frame(x =  x_line, y = intercept + k * x_line)
diag_neg <- data.frame(x = -x_line, y = intercept + k * abs(x_line))
# --- 3. Classify genes ---
df$status <- "NS"
df$status[df$log2FoldChange >=  fc_cut & df$pvalue <= p_cut] <- "Up"
df$status[df$log2FoldChange <= -fc_cut & df$pvalue <= p_cut] <- "Down"
df$status <- factor(df$status, levels = c("Up", "Down", "NS"))
# Top genes to label
top_up   <- df %>% filter(status == "Up")   %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% head(8) %>% pull(id)
top_down <- df %>% filter(status == "Down") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% head(8) %>% pull(id)
df$label <- ifelse(df$id %in% c(top_up, top_down), df$id, "")
# --- 4. Plot ---
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_p, colour = status)) +
  # NS background points (drawn first so they sit underneath)
  geom_point(data = subset(df, status == "NS"),
             aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_p),
             colour = "grey80", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  # Significant points
  geom_point(data = subset(df, status != "NS"),
             size = 1.1, alpha = 0.75) +
  # Diagonal cutoff lines (the defining feature of a diagonal volcano plot)
  geom_line(data = diag_pos, aes(x = x, y = y),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "#2C7FB8",
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(data = diag_neg, aes(x = x, y = y),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "#2C7FB8",
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # Reference axes at the conventional thresholds
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = intercept,
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # Gene labels
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label),
                  size = 3, max.overlaps = 100,
                  box.padding = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Up" = "#D7263D",
                                 "Down" = "#1B998B",
                                 "NS" = "grey80")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-max(abs(df$log2FoldChange)) - 0.5,
                                max(abs(df$log2FoldChange)) + 0.5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Synthetic volcano plot (Diagonal Volcano Plot)",
    subtitle = sprintf("|log2FC| ≥ %g  &  p ≤ %g  |  Diagonal: -log10(p) = %.2f + |log2FC|",
                       fc_cut, p_cut, intercept),
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = expression(-log[10](p~value)),
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))
# --- 5. Save figure ---
ggsave("processed/diagonal_volcano.png", p,
       width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 200)
ggsave("processed/diagonal_volcano.pdf", p,
       width = 9, height = 7)
cat("Saved processed/diagonal_volcano.png\n")
cat("Saved processed/diagonal_volcano.pdf\n")
